name: yf_stock_history
description:
Historical OHLCV bars for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance Ticker.history, prices adjusted for splits and dividends).
Returns: {symbol, period, interval, data_points (all bars in the period), truncated, prices: the most recent limit bars, oldest first, each {Date (or Datetime for intraday), Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits}}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, ytd, max; default 1y); interval (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1wk, 1mo; default 1d; Yahoo limits minute bars to recent days); limit (bars, 1-1000; default 500).
Several tickers at once: yf_multi_ticker_history; indices: yf_index_history; other sources: av_stock_daily, openbb_equity_price.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "6mo", "interval": "1d"}
